TRAFFIC ADVISORY
In view of the programme of Dawat-E-Iftar – 2026 at LB Stadium by the Hon’ble Chief Minister, the following traffic restrictions are likely to be implemented on need basis on 15.03.2026 between 5 p.m. and 10 p.m.

The traffic will be either stopped or diverted at the following places/routes on need basis:
1.Traffic coming from AR Petrol Pump Junction towards BJR Statue will be diverted at A.R. Petrol Pump towards Nampally Railway Station.
2.Traffic coming from Basheerbagh towards A.R. Petrol Pump will be diverted at BJR Statue towards SBI, Abids and Nampally Station road.  
3.Traffic coming from Sujatha School lane towards Khan Lateef Khan building will be diverted at Sujatha School junction towards Nampally.  
Junctions to be avoided between 5 p.m. to 10 p.m. on 15.03.2026:  
Lakdi Ka Pool, Iqbal Minar, Ravindra Bharathi, Hyderabad Traffic Police Junction, Basheerbagh, BJR Statue Circle, SBI Gunfoundry, A.R. Petrol Pump,                 KLK Building and Liberty.

RTC Buses:  
The RTC Buses plying from Ravindra Bharathi towards BJR Statue will be diverted at A.R. Petrol Pump towards Nampally Railway Station depending on the traffic situation as per the need.

Citizens are requested to take alternative routes to reach their destinations and avoid the above routes/junctions during the above specified timings and co-operate with the Traffic Police.  In case of any inconvenience in commuting, please contact the Hyderabad Traffic Police Helpline 9010203626

(D. Joel Davis, IPS.,)
Jt. Commissioner of Police,
Traffic, Hyderabad.

Traffic Advisory 

Special traffic arrangements will be in place in view of the “Run for Good Marathon” at JLN Stadium on 15.03.2026 (Sunday).

Traffic movement will be regulated/diverted on certain stretches in South Delhi and commuters may experience congestion near Lodhi Road and surrounding areas.

Time: 05:00 AM – 09:30 AM

📍 Traffic diversions will be in place at: Mehar Chand Market Signal, Kotla Red Light, 2nd Avenue–Jor Bagh Crossing, 4th Avenue–Jor Bagh Crossing & Lala Lajpat Rai Cut–CBI Building.

📍Heavy vehicles will not be permitted from JLN Stadium Red Light to B.P. Marg during the above time.

📍 Commuters are advised to plan their journey in advance, avoid affected stretches around JLN Stadium and use alternate routes/public transport wherever possible.

📍Stay updated through Delhi Traffic Police channels.

#DPTrafficAdvisory
